sql.value: select r.id, r.name, r.provider, r.config_json, r.threshold, r.action, r.target, r.sort, r.enable_status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from ai_moderation_rule r where r.is_deleted = 0 #[and r.name like concat('%', :name, '%')] #[and r.provider = :provider] #[and r.target = :target] #[and r.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by r.sort desc, r.id desc
select id, name, provider, config_json, threshold, action, target, sort, enable_status from ai_moderation_rule where is_deleted = 0 and enable_status = 1 order by sort desc, id desc
